## Ingredients

- 1/2 cup hot sauce
- 1 tbsp seasoning {{component:test-cajun-seasoning}}

## From Scratch

Warm the hot sauce and whisk in the seasoning.

## Note

Uses another shared component, so the seasoning is included transitively.
